findings.issue: The new r-3b rule that bans `std::process::Command::new` cannot go green under r-3b's own ownership and allowed expect sites. (1) Ownership: clippy only reports an unfulfilled `#[expect]` once the lint can fire, so the item-level `#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, ...)]` in `crates/sc-agent-types/src/git.rs` and `crates/sc-jev-check/src/extract/command.rs` must be added in the same sprint that adds the clippy.toml entry. That sprint is r-3b. But r-3b owned_paths (sprint-r-3b:65-108; line 82 covers only `crates/*/tests/**` and `crates/*/src/**/tests.rs`) contain neither file. No earlier sprint can add the line, because `unfulfilled_lint_expectations` plus `-D warnings` would fail that sprint. (2) Allowed sites: a-10 `crates/sc-jev-check/src/extract/mod.rs:87-132` has a `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) mod test_support` that calls `Command::new("git")` for git init and commit in fixtures. `sc_agent_types::git` cannot replace this, since it only has discover_toplevel and read_at_rev. `--all-targets` lints it. It is neither a listed production site nor a `tests.rs` or `tests/**` file, so `test_disallowed_methods_expect_sites` (r-3b:324-334) fails, or clippy fails. No sprint is told to move it.
findings.required_correction: Add both expect lines to r-3b owned_paths as 'crates/sc-agent-types/src/git.rs#expect line only' and 'crates/sc-jev-check/src/extract/command.rs#expect line only'. Then do one of two things. Option 1: have r-2 (which owns sc-jev-check/src) move `extract::test_support` to `src/extract/test_support/tests.rs` or another `**/tests.rs` path, and record that in the r-3b → r-2 must-follow row. Option 2: add `crates/sc-jev-check/src/extract/mod.rs` (cfg(test) module only) to the allowed sites in r-3b D7.3 and plan.md resolution 12. Also say in the plan that r-3b runs a pre-merge sweep, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` with the new entry, and that the PR lists every site it fixed.

findings.issue: Deleting ScriptedJudge drops the LLM-context refusal. ADR-SAG-0022 (architecture.md:238-239) still says a scripted LLM backend requires `JudgeRequest.llm`. After r-1, `register_scripted_backends` builds MockJudgeBackend instances, and their contract (r-1 D10.11) has no such check. Any CLI or pytest run with scripted Haiku or Luna and no resolved system prompt would then succeed. That contradicts the standing ADR sentence and hides a regression where the engine stops passing llm context. It also loses the a-10 unit test `scripted_judge_records_requests_and_counts_validations`, which pins the refusal and checks that a refused request is not recorded.
findings.required_correction: In r-1 D10.11, add a contract bullet: when `self.id().descriptor().requires_llm_context()` is true and the request carries no llm context, `validate_for_send` (counted) and `judge` return `INPUT_INVALID` and record nothing. Cover it in `test_mock_judge_backend_contract`. Restate it in the ADR-SAG-0022 r-1 amendment, or explicitly supersede the base sentence if the reviser chooses to drop the behaviour.

notes: Decisions judged sound. (1) ScriptedJudge and RequestLog deleted, apart from CPR-302. a-10's only shared-log use is sessions_exact.rs:276-295, which compares payload bytes, so per-mock `requests()` is enough. (2) execute_with_overrides deleted. `FileSessionStore::with_clock` exists at a-10 session/mod.rs:158, so moving clock and TTL coverage to sc-jev-check holds. (3) Jev confidence option (a) is coherent across r-1 D10.1, r-2 D2.6 (:186-192, no duplicate `answers` key, provider_meta kept in results[]) and ADR-SAG-0014 r-2 (architecture.md:735-743). (4) The D0 spike's three outcomes are explicit, and each names the later lines it changes. (5) bin_path at a fixed target/workspace-tests-bin is an acceptable deviation, since isolation from the uplift path is kept. (6) The scripted-answers `{"backends": {...}}` form is fully specified: failure stages map to with_failure and refusing, the rejection cases are listed, and four tests cover it. (7) Moving sha2 to core is correct, because the sc-treesitter library calls Sha256Digest::of.
